'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Somali Civil War (2009–present)|Somali Civil War]]
**[[August 2022 Mogadishu attack|2022 Mogadishu hotel attack]]
***The siege at a hotel seized by [[Al-Shabaab (militant group)|al-Shabaab]] fighters in [[Mogadishu]] ends with the deaths of all of the attackers. Twenty-one other people were killed, and 117 others were injured. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2022/8/21/somali-forces-end-al-shabab-siege-at-mogadishu-hotel-report (Al Jazeera)] [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-62621205 (BBC News)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2022 Afghanistan floods]]
**Nine people are killed by heavy flooding in [[Khoshi District]], [[Logar Province|Logar]], [[Afghanistan]]. [https://apnews.com/article/afghanistan-floods-kabul-climate-and-environment-c7577d1b081114ed288f290816c415e5 (AP)]
*Sixteen people are killed and three others are injured when a truck collides with a minibus in [[Ulyanovsk Oblast]], [[Russia]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/least-14-dead-after-minibus-collides-with-lorry-russia-police-2022-08-21/ (Reuters)]
*At least 50 people are killed by flooding caused by heavy rains in [[Himachal Pradesh]] and [[Uttarakhand]], [[India]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/india/floods-landslides-kill-dozens-monsoon-rains-lash-northern-eastern-india-2022-08-21/ (Reuters)]
*Nine soldiers are killed and four others are injured when their truck plunges into a ravine in [[Azad Kashmir]], [[Pakistan]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/nine-soldiers-die-truck-plunges-into-ravine-pakistani-kashmir-2022-08-21/ (Reuters)]

**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Japan]]
***[[Prime Minister of Japan|Prime Minister]] [[Fumio Kishida]] [[COVID testing|tests]] positive for [[COVID-19]]. [https://english.kyodonews.net/news/2022/08/004f649fe2f2-breaking-news-japan-pm-kishida-tests-positive-for-covid-19-govt.html (Kyodo News)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Iran–United Arab Emirates relations]]
**The [[United Arab Emirates]] announces the reinstallation of its ambassador to [[Iran]], which will take effect "in the coming days", more than six years after it cut off diplomatic relations with the [[Islamic republic]]. [https://www.channelnewsasia.com/world/uae-upgrading-ties-iran-says-envoy-return-tehran-within-days-2891581 (CNA)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[LGBT rights in Singapore]]
**[[Prime Minister of Singapore|Prime Minister]] [[Lee Hsien Loong]] says that [[Singapore]] will decriminalize [[Section 377A of the Penal Code (Singapore)|sex between men]], which is illegal under a colonial-era law, while also amending the Constitution to define marriage as a [[heterosexual]] union. [https://www.channelnewsasia.com/singapore/section-377a-repeal-law-sex-gay-men-marriage-constitution-pm-lee-ndr2022-2891381 (CNA)]
*Oleksandr Nakonechny, regional head of the [[Security Service of Ukraine]] in [[Kirovohrad Oblast]], is found dead in his apartment in an apparent suicide. [https://interfax.com.ua/news/general/853616.html (Interfax Ukraine)]

'''Sports'''
*[[2022 Western & Southern Open]]
**In [[tennis]], world number 156 [[Borna Ćorić]] of [[Croatia]] becomes the lowest-ranked champion in the [[ATP Tour Masters 1000]] after defeating [[Stefanos Tsitsipas]] of [[Greece]] in the [[2022 Western & Southern Open – Men's singles|men's singles]] final of the 2022 [[Cincinnati Masters]]. [https://sports.inquirer.net/474410/coric-upsets-tsitsipas-to-win-cincinnati-masters-title (''Philippine Daily Inquirer'')]
**World number 17 [[Caroline Garcia]] of [[France]] becomes the first [[Qualifier (tennis)|qualifier]] to win a [[WTA 1000 tournament]] after defeating [[Petra Kvitová]] of the [[Czech Republic]] in the [[2022 Western & Southern Open – Women's singles|women's singles]] final of the 2022 Cincinnati Masters. [https://sportstar.thehindu.com/tennis/caroline-garcia-beats-petra-kvitova-wins-2022-cincinnati-masters/article65795445.ece (''Sportstar'')]
